note: Camping spots on the Rice County Fairgrounds in Faribault, rented outside the fair; no water in freezing weather, and no bathrooms or showers on the grounds. Across from the city water park. --Claude
summary: Fair's own pages read: about 22 spots rented outside events ('Unless you are renting a camping spot or a facility, overnight stay is not permitted'); $65 electric+water / $40 no hookups (no unit stated, so nightly_low/high left unset); public dump on the west side; no bathrooms or showers. Amperage, season and booking method not stated. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Fairgrounds test (ordinary nights): the fair rents camping spots to the public outside events: fairground-info lists 'RV spots with or without water and electric for rent (no water in winter)', and the location page says 'Unless you are renting a camping spot or a facility, overnight stay is not permitted.' The camping page offers 'about 22 camping spots'. No visitor/exhibitor restriction stated. Read as passing; the pages do not say how to book (contact page gives the fair office (507) 332-2470, June-July only, and email).

Fees: '$65 for spots with electric and water, $40 for spots without hookups' with no unit (night/stay) stated; nightly_low/high left unset and the rates kept in fees.note. The old note's '$60 W/E / $45 no-hookup' is superseded. Local entry, so no price gate; RV Life lists it at a 3-$ tier.

Ownership: the site is run by the Rice County Fair (the county agricultural society), whose camping proceeds 'cover expenses to run the annual fair'; reviewer may weigh local vs private (a non-profit fair association). Kept local.
Hookups: page says 'electric and water' with no amperage; stored electric 50 (derived from old note) left as stored, unconfirmed.
Season: stored year_round true (derived) not restated; the pages imply winter rental ('no water in winter', 'no water during freezing season') but give no season; left as stored.
Booking: stored reservable true / platform phone (derived) not confirmed; no booking method stated on the fair's pages. Left as stored.
Phone: stored 507-332-2470 is the fair office secretary's line, staffed 'June-July only'; off-season the manager is by email/appointment (cell (507) 412-9168 'urgent only'). Kept.

Pin 44.30991,-93.27264 sits on MN-3 at the fairgrounds' east edge; the camping spots could not be picked out on imagery, so no move proposed. The Straight River/Cannon River lie east and south across the highway, not beside any identifiable spots; not waterfront kept.

Note cleaned: dropped prices, pedestal/amp detail, 'book by phone/email' and 'fits a 33-ft trailer per review' (unsourced on the operator's pages); 'year-round outside fair events' reworded to what the page says.
